title: Concept: Set-Cookie header carries an encoded line break
description: A percent-encoded CRLF inside Set-Cookie shows that request data reached a response header unfiltered. The Location header gets attention because redirects are obvious; cookies are copied from user input just as often and are less often reviewed.
applicability: Responses that set a cookie whose value is derived from client input.
risk: An intermediary that decodes the value before forwarding can be made to emit a second header under the site origin, enabling cache poisoning or script injection.
